shortDescription: Generate OpenVPN tls-auth key or create an Easy-RSA client and inline .ovpn configuration

options.name: chdir
options.description: Change into this directory before executing commands and accessing the PKI structure. For C(state=create_user), paths are expected relative to this working directory (e.g. C(pki/private), C(pki/issued), C(pki/reqs)).

options.name: creates
options.description: If this path exists, the module returns early with no changes. With C(state=genkey), the early-return message is C(tls-auth key already created). With C(force=true) and C(creates) set, the marker file is removed before the check.

options.name: destination_directory
options.description: Target directory where the generated client configuration C(<username>.ovpn) is written when C(state=create_user).

options.name: easyrsa_directory
options.description: Reserved for future use (currently not used by the module implementation).

options.name: force
options.description: If enabled and C(creates) is set, removes the marker file before checking C(creates).

options.name: secret
options.description: Destination path for the generated OpenVPN static key when C(state=genkey). Required by the module interface even if C(state=create_user).

options.name: state
options.description: Operation mode. C(genkey) generates a static key file using the OpenVPN binary. C(create_user) creates an Easy-RSA client (key/cert) and generates an inline C(.ovpn) file using a template.

options.name: username
options.description: Client username to create when C(state=create_user).
